explication: This small Python script generates dated Git commits in a new local repository and optionally pushes them to a remote. The README documents controls for commit frequency, daily count, weekends, date range, and Git identity; these are options within the single runtime script, not separate subsystems. The graph follows the documented CLI-to-generation workflow. External Git behavior is represented at the subprocess boundary; no other source files implement runtime product behavior.
